shared_elements: upright slab/stela format with carved relief
winged/curved emblem or headdress motif at top
figures shown with heads in profile
justification: Both are upright inscribed stelae combining a small figural scene with blocks of glyphic signs, and both show human figures with heads in profile beneath a curving emblematic element at the top. But A is dominated by many long horizontal lines of small text with a tiny lunette scene of kneeling worshippers before a winged disc, whereas B is dominated by one or two large, elaborately costumed standing figures with plumed headdresses facing each other, the glyphs reduced to a small block; the figural proportions, costume conventions and the text-to-image balance are quite different.
